verdict.rationale: Community users report bulk ingestion working: batch indexing of 7M articles (comm-16), 1,000,000 records sent and it 'just worked' (comm-18), and batch indexing resolving a backlog on ~80M documents (comm-15). One user found that frequent updates to ~50k changing records fell hours behind (comm-9). First-party docs in the pack only mention 'adding documents' (docs-2) and MCP-driven document indexing (docs-57), with no documented batch endpoints. missing for 10: first-party documentation of bulk/batch add, update and delete operations (e.g. delete-by-filter, partial updates across many documents), bulk operations exposed to AI agents via MCP, and reliable bulk updates on high-churn data.
